need: The template's pre-commit job stages files Lockstep rewrote without failing on a rewritten file git ignores (docs/status.md).

searched.found: The job pipes every rewritten path to xargs git add; the template ignores docs/status.md, so git add exits 1 for it.

searched.query: add only paths git does not ignore
searched.found: git add refuses an ignored path unless -f; --ignore-errors does not change that exit status; git check-ignore -q exits 0 for an ignored path.

candidates.name: git check-ignore filter before git add
candidates.covers: Skips exactly the ignored paths; any other add failure still fails the job.

candidates.name: git add -f
candidates.misses: Would commit the ignored status page, which new copies keep out of git on purpose.

gap: None; git's own check-ignore is used.
